title: Temporal clocks must remain separate
content: The canvas contains a week-number A/B/C/D cycle, a weekday-only date presentation, a continuous all-calendar-day Code 2 cycle, and instrument-specific long cycles. A system must identify calendar_mode before computing a state.

title: Week-letter rule
content: Weeks repeat A, B, C, D using (week_number-1) mod 4. The source maps weeks 1 through 52 accordingly.

title: Week C Month C hypothesis
content: The canvas states that Week C and Month C swings are golden, but does not define Month C, swing qualification, instrument, timeframe, or evidence.

title: Weekday calendar
content: The month-by-month table advances A/B/C/D across listed weekdays and omits weekends. It is a separate mode from the continuous daily code.

title: Continuous Code 2
content: Code 2 advances A→B→C→D every calendar day without resets, including weekends, anchored at January 1, 2025 = A.

title: Calendar ambiguity
content: The weekday-only and continuous-calendar-day modes can diverge. Never calculate a letter without an explicit calendar_mode.

title: Quarterly ledger status
content: The quarterly/year-close node is a dense research ledger containing numbered observations, percentages, rekeys, pullbacks, invalidations, color overlaps, and super-cycle notes. It is not yet a canonical executable playbook.

title: USDNOK cycle phases
content: USD/NOK uses non-overlapping 60-calendar-day windows: observation Day 0–11, measurement Day 12–22, entry Day 23, and delivery Day 23–60.

title: USDNOK levels
content: For the Day 12–22 range: TP1 is high + 0.25×range, TP2 is high + 0.50×range, and invalidation is low - 0.32×range.

title: USDNOK evidence status
content: The canvas states 16 TP1 hits in 18 historical cycles, or 88.89%. This remains unverified until independently reproduced with exact data and event-order rules.

title: Temporal engine boundary
content: Temporal states provide context and may condition expectancy, but they do not independently define a complete entry, stop, target, or closure.

title: Missing linked source
content: The linked file trading/ART OF TRADE.md points directly into the quarterly research branch but was not included, making it a material reconstruction gap.
